answer: Sybil resistance rests on bonded collateral escrows: when k identities coordinate equivocation, correlated evidence triggers aggregate penalties proportional to k², so splitting stake does not dilute liability. Detection further applies an exponential multiplier to swarm-wide capital loss; asymmetric depreciation can leave recovered value below the bond at risk. A pulse of cheap identities cannot hide in the shale of separate keys or cross the canyon between accounts: shared behavior ties them to one costly event.
